Outreach Program
Outreach Program
NCPOR personnel have also been active in conducting outreach programs. Many schools were visited and the team interacted with the school children to introduce them to the field of scientific research, particularly Research Antarctic Science. The team also actively participated in various scientific fairs. A brief look at the outreach program are given here.
Participation at India International Science Festival (IISF), New Delhi, 7-11 December, 2016
NCAOR Participation at India International Trade Fair, New Delhi, Nov., 14-27, 2016
